integrity: The statement is an analytic consequence of the source's displayed matching weights and logical-complement construction. No simulation or finite enumeration is used as evidence for the all-parameter claim. Self-review checked the boundary cases and the distinction between the local comparison and the full detector-error model.
scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the source's explicit on-chain packet-versus-logical-complement weight comparison. It does not prove full-MWPM fault tolerance beyond the paper's proposed ceiling, because other syndrome-equivalent matchings and multi-fault events remain possible.
title: The local correlation-aware weight comparison has no half-distance ceiling
